items.title: Your Algorithm: Giving People More Ways to Personalize Facebook Recommendations
items.summary: Your algorithm is a suite of AI-powered tools that makes Facebook recommendations more transparent and steerable, with a single editable view of the interests that shape Feed and Reels. We’re sharing how Your algorithm turns people’s natural language preferences into responsive recommendations, and how LLMs are tailored to specific tasks within the system. items.title: How We Built TLX: A Hardware-Native GPU Compiler for Production ML at Scale
items.summary: Triton Low-Level Extensions (TLX), is an extension to Triton that helps engineers optimize GPU performance while preserving Triton’s productive programming model.  TLX introduces explicit warp-group and cluster-level orchestration, letting developers adopt new hardware capabilities without sacrificing velocity.  TLX has demonstrated performance improvements in RecSys training, RecSys inference, and large-scale LLM pretraining.
